description: Defines minimal types for Microsoft Teams SDK interactions, including activity and turn context structures, used to interact with Teams messages and events.

methods.name: sendActivity
methods.description: Sends a single activity (message or event) to the user with a Promise-based interface.

methods.name: sendActivities
methods.description: Sends multiple activities simultaneously, returning a Promise.

methods.name: updateActivity
methods.description: Updates an existing activity, returning a Promise with optional activity id.

methods.name: deleteActivity
methods.description: Deletes an activity by its ID, returning a Promise.
